counter_events.coalescing: Sticky flags and retained booleans may merge wraps. No elapsed-wrap count, timestamp queue, exact wider encoder history or lossless delivery is promised.
counter_events.software_update: Mask/suppress requests during software UG and retire UIF before normal observation. Classic ATIM temporarily clears URS for UG and restores URS before counting.
counter_events.shared_vector: L012 GTIM3 and GTIM4 share GTIM34, with independent gate/reset/status and handlers; no sibling MMIO or shared-vector disable/unpend/reprioritize.

unsupported_hardware: CH4 external input/capture; manual explicitly internal comparison-only
CW32F030.capture_protocol: CSy=1; BKSy=0 disabled,1 rising,2 falling,3 both; CHxCR.CIEA bit8/CIEB bit9 requests; CxyF flags bits2..7, CxyE loss flags bits8..13. Read CCR then explicit R1W0 ICR acknowledgement; no documented read-clear. EN=0 does not disable capture.
CW32F030.encoder_protocol: MSCR.SMS=4/5/6 counts CH1A/CH1B/both edges; MSCR.IA1S=0 and IB1S=0 direct pins; CR.DIR hardware-maintained; FLTR.CCP1A/CCP1B inversion; FLT encoding0xx off,100 PCLK 3 samples,101 PCLK/4,110 PCLK/16,111 PCLK/64. Own timing requirement: phase separation greater than one TCLK, each input pulse width greater than two TCLK.

clock.page_convention: Printed page equals zero-based PDF index; PDF viewer one-based page=printed+1. Encoder block-diagram page images were visually inspected in all seven own manuals.

qualification.not_a_claim: This is register/source design qualification, not silicon validation, electrical/package route qualification, lossless position history, or a promised maximum encoder rate.

qei_policy.classification: Bounded source-composition/API policy; fixed PRS=/1, MODE=2, nonzero ARR, disabled unused capture, and no rate setter are scope choices, not encoder-specific vendor mandates.

capture_policy.clock_basis: Counter TCLK is selected internal PCLK after PRS; filter sampling separately uses unprescaled PCLK divided by its native filter encoding. Use existing qualified PCLK bounds, not a copied GTIM rule.
capture_policy.classification: Full-range timestamp policy; changing PRS changes capture timebase; no new maximum external edge-rate guarantee.

explicit_facts.fact: CR.CT bit2 selects0internal PCLK or1external ETR; CR.PRS6:4 encodes1,2,4,8,16,32,64,256. Encoder block diagram places TCLK after this selector.

Encoder SMS4 counts CH1A edges, SMS5 CH1B edges, SMS6 both channels; filtered IAFP/IBFP phase determines hardware direction. PCLK is the timing basis, not a claim that free-running PCLK ticks add to encoder position.
Filter clocks are independently PCLK based: codes0xx disabled;100=PCLK,101=PCLK/4,110=PCLK/16,111=PCLK/64, three consecutive valid samples. CCP1A/B0normal1inverted for slave input.
ARR/CNT are16bit. Generic edge-aligned up-count wraps after ARR to0; down-count wraps after0 toARR. SDK declares ReloadValue0000..ffff.

MODE00/01 reserved,10edge-aligned,11central-aligned. No own register restriction couples SMS4/5/6 exclusively toMODE3; encoder worked prose mentions central alignment but gives no exclusive requirement.
DIR0up/1down. Register table says writable only in edge alignment, otherwise read-only; encoder prose explicitly says filtered phase affectsDIR. Software updates/resets can clearDIR.
CSA/B1 selects capture; BKS0 disables CCR capture and1/2/3 selectrising/falling/both capture edges. Encoder edge mode is selected separately throughSMS.

bounded_inferences_and_limits: MODE2+SMS4/5/6 is composed from independently documented legal fields and corroborated by separate SDK base-init/slave-config. Missing an encoder-specific MODE2 example is not evidence that the combination is unsupported. No new silicon proof is claimed.

CSA=CSB=1 and BKSA=BKSB=0 selects input/filter interpretation while disabling unused CCR capture. The encoder block diagram shows IAFP/IBFP feeding decoder timing independently of CCR capture. This is a source-composable bounded policy; the sources do not say BKS3 is an encoder prerequisite.

ARR1..65535 excludes a degenerate zero range by API policy. Full range65535 is optional for QEI and chosen for capture; neither is imported from classic GTIM. No ATIM ARR0-stops guarantee is asserted.

TCLK clock selection is qualified, but pulse width is not silently equated with period. x030 printed255/PDF256 divide-by2 waveform shows narrow TCLK pulses. Own manuals give no universal encoder Hz formula, synchronizer latency, filter phase margin, or encoder prescaler-as-edge-decimator guarantee.

Fixed CT0/PRS0 avoids offering unqualified encoder prescaler/external-clock combinations. Required phase/pulse conditions remain the own-manual conditions, plus separate actual clock/pin/electrical conditions; no numeric throughput promise.

Counter wrap topology composes with selected edge mode and ARR; separately read DIR/CNT/overflow are not an atomic history. Do not infer a wider exact signed count or promise a signal-level direction truth table.

Generic down-count start narrative says EN1 loadsARR. Encoder text does not separately specify restart/load precedence with hardwareDIR. No exact position-preserving start/stop guarantee follows merely from preservingMODE; runtime must state any restart/reinitialization contract explicitly.
source_conflicts: All seven own SDK ATIM header prescaler validators omitDIV32 even though they defineDIV32 and each own manual explicitly mapsPRS=5 to/32. The manual/register definition governs; the validator omission is not a hardware restriction.
All own encoder examples spell TTIM_MSCR once; the actual ATIM_MSCR register table and own SDK SMS symbols establish theATIM fields.
Encoder direction truth-table column layout is not used to promise signal-level direction; only documented DIR0up/1down and SMS edge-source semantics are admitted.

own_source_findings.mode: MODE0/1 reserved; MODE2 edge and MODE3 central are documented. No MODE2+SMS4/5/6 prohibition in own CR/MSCR/encoder text. SDK configures MODE and SMS independently.
own_source_findings.arr: ARR and CNT are16bit; no encoder-specific ARR=ffff mandate or ARR0-stops rule found in the inspected ATIM chapter; SDK ReloadValue says0000..ffff.
own_source_findings.direct_input: IA1S=0 and IB1S=0 select CH1A and CH1B.
own_source_findings.direction: Encoder filtered phase determines count direction and DIR; DIR0up/1down. No signal truth table or coherent multi-register snapshot claim.
own_source_findings.timing: Own encoder text requires phase separation >one TCLK pulse width and channel pulse width >two TCLK pulse widths. Exact latency/throughput formula is not given.
own_source_findings.capture_vs_encoder_gate: CSA/B selects capture/filter interpretation; BKS gates CCR capture acceptance; SMS selects encoder edges. No BKS-nonzero requirement appears in own encoder description.

classic_atim_input.exclusions: External CH4, uncorroborated AF routes, reserved pads and unbonded package pins are not admitted. Qualified generic aliases retain the common intersection of applicable packages.

source_conflicts: L012 GTIM uses actual SDK/PAC IER.UIE despite manual DIER wording; its ATIM genuinely uses DIER.UIE.
Classic ATIM update prose says ICR.UIE; the actual register field is UIF.
L052 MSCR bit4 is reserved in its own manual; leave zero despite the imported MSM name.
F003 omits DMA fields; no normalization or alias of that typed contract.
Classic GTIM ICR bits7/8 and classic ATIM bit1 are reserved reset-one and must be preserved.
L010 own manual singleton GTIM is named GTIM1 by the SDK/PAC token, IRQ and gate/reset fields; it is one bank, not a second instance.
validation_limits: Source and data qualification only; no board wiring, electrical edge throughput, interrupt latency or silicon validation is implied.
